import numpy as np
def fit(cols,names):
    A=np.column_stack(cols)
    c,res,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,sigma,rcond=None)
    pred=A@c
    nmse=np.mean((pred-sigma)**2)/np.var(sigma)
    print(nmse, dict(zip(names,np.round(c,4))))
    return c

import numpy as np, scipy.optimize as so
def tryfit(name,f,p0s):
    best=None
    for p0 in p0s:
        try:
            r=so.least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-sigma, p0, method='lm', max_nfev=20000)
            v=np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(sigma)
            if np.isfinite(v) and (best is None or v<best[0]): best=(v,r.x)
        except Exception as ex: pass
    print(name, best[0] if best else None, np.round(best[1],4) if best else None)

import numpy as np, scipy.optimize as so
rng=np.random.default_rng(1)
def tryfit(name,f,n,N=40):
    best=None
    for _ in range(N):
        p0=rng.uniform(-1,2,n)
        try:
            with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
                r=so.least_squares(lambda p: np.nan_to_num(f(p)-sigma,nan=1e3,posinf=1e3,neginf=-1e3), p0, method='trf', max_nfev=5000)
            v=np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(sigma)
            if np.isfinite(v) and (best is None or v<best[0]): best=(v,r.x)
        except Exception: pass
    print(name, best[0], np.round(best[1],4))
